description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Damwelkatuwa East, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - (24/55061)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property and registration of land titles under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land information including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, land extents, and certificate of title numbers, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
